For the SIG intake we're compiling a short narrative and artifacts around pull request review practices, CI/CD gating, and secrets escrow/rotation for production releases. Best,

Hi Peter / SIG team — attaching the requested narrative and artifacts for your intake. Summary below; full artifacts attached and a Drive link provided.

Attachments included: pr-review-snapshot.pdf (one-page narrative + policy headers), ci-gate-timeline.csv (per-rollout gate timestamps), secrets-escrow-summary.txt (secret storage & rotation snapshot). Drive mirror: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1XyExampleDriveLink

Executive summary (brief):
- PR review: All production-impacting repositories require at least one approver from the designated OWNERS file and one automated approval gate (successful CI + linter). We enforce branch protection requiring status checks and disallow merge until approvals and passing CI. PR metadata export (CSV) includes author, reviewer(s), approvals, and merge timestamp. The pr-review-snapshot.pdf highlights our reviewer assignment policy and escalation path for emergency merges.
- CI/CD gating: CI pipelines include a build, unit test, integration test, security scan (static analyzer), and canary deploy. The gate timeline CSV shows gate start/end timestamps for the last three production rollouts and records automated holds (e.g., failing security scan paused deployment). Gates are orchestrated by our platform with automatic retries; manual intervention is logged and requires sign-off by release engineer.
- Secrets stewardship: Secrets are stored in a company-managed KMS-backed vault (customer-managed keys for Private deployments upon request). Short-lived tokens are minted for runners and sampled at a 1% frequency for entitlement review; rotation for service tokens is on a 90-day cycle, HSM-backed KMS keys rotate annually. The secrets-escrow-summary.txt contains a redacted inventory of secret types and custodians.

Notes on redaction and privacy: developer comment bodies were redacted; timestamps and approval events are preserved. If you need raw build logs, we can provide an auditor-view export under an NDA.

Next steps: confirm receipt and let us know if you need expanded logs or any additional attestations.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Security & Controls
Redwood Inference
